title: POPS: Recovering Unlearned Multi-Modality Knowledge in MLLMs

summary.claim: Multimodal machine unlearning is not robust once a model is published. POPS optimizes a prompt suffix to make the model generate candidate private data and fine-tunes on it, recovering nearly all erased information.
summary.condition: An attacker with access to a published unlearned MLLM; several multimodal unlearning benchmarks.
summary.gap: (Inferred) Only the attack is proposed; no unlearning method that resists this recovery is given.
